title: Let the divided mind become one act
summary: The mind under duality stays unfinished until it surrenders through the Guru. Begin where the split is loudest, and let one guided act gather the heart back into One.
takeaway: Answer divided allegiance with one surrendered act.
lifeApplication: Name the place where you are trying to serve two masters. Choose the Guru-led act that costs your ego something small and do it before the argument resumes.

source.shortMeaning: The mind ruled by evil intellect and duality becomes one only when it surrenders through the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: Let the next decision show which allegiance you are no longer feeding.

evidence.coreClaim: The mind ruled by evil intellect and duality becomes one only when it surrenders through the Guru.
evidence.turn: The cited lines name duality as the mind's bondage and surrender through the Guru as the movement into oneness.
